buildCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');if(fs.existsSync('frontend/package.json')){cp.execSync('cd frontend && npm install && npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'});if(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')){fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','dist',{recursive:true});}}else{cp.execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'})}"
